SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM v_activities GROUP BY variant ORDER BY row_count DESC, variant

SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS row_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE length(flags) > 0) AS flagged_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=')) AS censored_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=')) AS unknown_relation_rows FROM v_activities GROUP BY variant ORDER BY row_count DESC, variant

SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS censored_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_relation_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_rows FROM v_activities GROUP BY variant ORDER BY row_count DESC, variant

SELECT c.inchikey, c.target, c.variant, c.assay_type, c.n_records, c.n_sources, c.median_pic50, c.spread_pic50, c.conflict, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_activities a WHERE a.inchikey = c.inchikey AND a.variant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.variant AND a.assay_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.assay_type AND a.relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=')) AS censored_activity_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_activities a WHERE a.inchikey = c.inchikey AND a.variant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.variant AND a.assay_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.assay_type AND (a.relation IS NULL OR a.relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>='))) AS unknown_relation_activity_rows, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_activities a WHERE a.inchikey = c.inchikey AND a.variant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.variant AND a.assay_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.assay_type AND length(a.flags) > 0) AS flagged_activity_rows FROM v_consensus c WHERE c.spread_pic50 = (SELECT MAX(spread_pic50) FROM v_consensus)

SELECT inchikey, target, variant, assay_type, n_records, n_sources, median_pic50, spread_pic50, conflict, member_uids FROM v_consensus WHERE spread_pic50 = (SELECT MAX(spread_pic50) FROM v_consensus) ORDER BY inchikey, variant, assay_type

SELECT inchikey, variant, assay_type, spread_pic50, n_records, n_sources, conflict, member_uids FROM v_consensus WHERE spread_pic50 = (SELECT MAX(spread_pic50) FROM v_consensus)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS censored_or_unknown_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS unknown_relation_rows FROM v_activities WHERE relation IS NULL OR relation <> '='

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_visible_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN TRIM(relation) IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR TRIM(relation) NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS unknown_relation_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR TRIM(relation) <> '=' THEN 1 END) AS censored_or_unknown_rows FROM v_activities

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_visible_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS unknown_relation_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation <> '=' THEN 1 END) AS censored_or_unknown_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN (relation IS NULL OR relation <> '=') AND length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS flagged_censored_or_unknown_rows FROM v_activities

SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS all_nonnull_pic50, MEDIAN(pic50) AS all_median_pic50, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 END) AS exact_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS exact_nonnull_pic50, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS exact_median_pic50, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) - MEDIAN(pic50) AS median_change_exact_minus_all, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS unknown_relation_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS flagged_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS exact_flagged_rows FROM v_activities

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_all_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS n_all_pic50, MEDIAN(pic50) AS median_pic50_all, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 END) AS n_exact_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS n_exact_pic50, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS median_pic50_exact, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) - MEDIAN(pic50) AS change_exact_minus_all, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS n_censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS n_unknown_relation_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_flagged_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_flagged_exact_rows FROM v_activities

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_all_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS n_all_pic50, MEDIAN(pic50) AS median_pic50_all, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 END) AS n_exact_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS n_exact_pic50, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) AS median_pic50_exact, MEDIAN(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN pic50 END) - MEDIAN(pic50) AS change_exact_minus_all, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS n_censored_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 END) AS n_unknown_relation_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_flagged_rows, COUNT(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 END) AS n_flagged_exact_rows FROM v_activities

SELECT COUNT(*) AS compounds_without_exact, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_censored = 1 AND has_unknown = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS censored_only, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_censored = 0 AND has_unknown = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknown_only, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_censored = 1 AND has_unknown = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS censored_and_unknown, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_flagged = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS compounds_with_flagged_rows FROM (SELECT inchikey, MAX(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_exact, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_censored, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_unknown, MAX(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_flagged FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' GROUP BY inchikey) AS compounds WHERE has_exact = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS compounds_with_no_exact_measurement, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_censored = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS compounds_with_censored_relations, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_unknown = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS compounds_with_unknown_relations, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_flagged = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS compounds_with_flagged_rows FROM (SELECT inchikey, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_censored, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_unknown, MAX(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_flagged FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' GROUP BY inchikey HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) AS nonexact_compounds

SELECT COUNT(*) AS compounds_with_no_exact_measurement, COUNT(CASE WHEN has_censored = 1 THEN 1 END) AS with_censored_relations, COUNT(CASE WHEN has_unknown = 1 THEN 1 END) AS with_unknown_relations, COUNT(CASE WHEN has_flags = 1 THEN 1 END) AS with_flagged_rows FROM (SELECT inchikey, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_censored, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_unknown, MAX(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_flags FROM v_activities GROUP BY inchikey HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) AS compounds_without_exact

SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS censored_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN length(flags) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_censored_rows FROM v_activities WHERE relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') GROUP BY source ORDER BY censored_rows DESC, source
